events.text: Battle of Stamford Bridge: King Harold II defeats the invading Norwegian army.
Vasco Núñez de Balboa becomes the first European to see the Pacific from the Americas.
Publick Occurrences, the first newspaper in the American colonies, is published in Boston.
Congress passes twelve amendments, ten of which become the U.S. Bill of Rights.
TAT-1, the first transatlantic telephone cable, enters service.
U.S. Army troops escort the Little Rock Nine into Central High School.
Sandra Day O'Connor becomes the first woman on the U.S. Supreme Court.
China launches Shenzhou 7, which carries out the country's first spacewalk.
